column4: Upstream docs/admin/install.rst requires PostgreSQL 15+ and Valkey/Redis for cache and task queue; chart wires both unconditionally.
Chart _configmap.tpl hard-wires the postgres JDBC driver with no alternative; UNVERIFIED: upstream engine support (bitbucket source not reachable).
values.yaml enables postgres with no alternative and no toggle; UNVERIFIED: upstream README did not state engine support.
Upstream m1k1o/blog README: runs on SQLite by default, MySQL or Postgres optional; chart wires postgres only.
Chart sets Database.Type postgres and Redis.Server in templates; UNVERIFIED: upstream sqlite default and optional Redis not confirmed in the fetched README.
Upstream etebase_server/settings.py defaults to sqlite3 and sets Redis only when redis_uri is configured (chart values.yaml enables both).
Upstream packages/server/src/DataSource.ts supports sqlite with local database.sqlite; docker/.env.example comments out DATABASE_TYPE; chart sets DATABASE_TYPE postgres.
Upstream gaseous-project README: MariaDB preferred, MySQL supported, no embedded alternative; chart wires mariadb.
Upstream conf/defaults.ini uses sqlite3 by default (postgres via GF_DATABASE_TYPE optional); sidecar only provisions dashboards.

Upstream Guacamole can run without a DB via user-mapping; chart db-wait initContainer gates startup on postgres, so it is effectively needed in this chart. guacd is a separate remote-desktop backend; the web app starts without it.
Upstream packages/server/README.md: SQLite is the default and PostgreSQL is for production use; chart wires postgres.
Upstream mattermost README states it relies on PostgreSQL; chart sets MM_SQLSETTINGS_DRIVERNAME postgres.
Upstream docs/configuring-metabase/config-file.md lists h2 as the embedded engine (Metabase default when no DB is configured); chart wires postgres via MB_DB_TYPE.
Upstream README: Redis is required for caching; chart enables redis without a toggle.
open-webui (uiImage) is a UI container in the same chart; the Ollama API runs without it.
Upstream README compose uses postgres as the only database; chart wires postgres unconditionally.
Chart sets PHOTOPRISM_DATABASE_DRIVER mysql; UNVERIFIED: upstream README did not mention the embedded SQLite default, decided from upstream knowledge.
Chart wires MySQL/MariaDB env (no alternative in upstream README); Redis role via CACHE_HOST not verified, treated as optional cache.
values.yaml defines beImage (portainer-ee) but no chart template references it; the app runs as portainer-ce.
Upstream docker-library README documents an SQLite3 mode (testing, not multi-user) with a database container recommended; chart wires postgres.
Upstream lib/config.ts: CACHE_TYPE defaults to memory, so Redis is optional; browserless chrome is only needed for browser-based routes.
Upstream util/config.go: SEMAPHORE_DB_DIALECT defaults to sqlite; mysql and postgres are optional.
Upstream README: SQLite is the preferred mode and needs no DB container; MariaDB/MySQL are optional.
Upstream README lists SQLite as a supported database alongside PostgreSQL and MySQL; chart sets DATABASE_CLIENT postgres. Default client not confirmed in fetched text.
Upstream README: embedded H2 database is used when no PostgreSQL config is provided.
Upstream setup/traccar.xml defaults to embedded H2 (database.driver org.h2.Driver); chart sets postgres driver.
Upstream config/database.php supports sqlite but defaults to mysql; chart wires pgsql. Optional is a judgment call since sqlite is an embedded engine the app accepts.
